## Church leaders

Build the thriving-oriented church: redefine success metrics away from attendance and giving toward relationship, formation, and neighborhood impact (Module 9's dashboard, now operational); redesign gatherings for deep interaction over passive consumption; adopt a "less is more" program philosophy and a *Slow Church* culture — depth over speed, process over immediate results; develop a digital-discipleship framework where tools enhance rather than replace embodied fellowship; implement collective resource stewardship (tool libraries, carpools, skill exchanges); and root the congregation ever deeper in its actual neighborhood.
